### 14M1

```{r}
a <- 3.5 # average morning wait time
b <- -1 # average difference afternoon wait time
sigma_a <- 1 # std dev in intercepts
sigma_b <- 0.5 # std dev in slopes
rho <- -0 # correlation between intercepts and slopes

# the next three lilnes of code simply combine the terms, above
mu <- c(a, b)

cov_ab <- sigma_a * sigma_b * rho
sigma <- matrix(c(sigma_a^2, cov_ab,
                  cov_ab, sigma_b^2), ncol = 2)

library(tidyverse)

sigmas <- c(sigma_a, sigma_b) # standard deviation
rho <- matrix(c(1, rho,
                rho, 1), nrow = 2)

# now matrix multiply to get covariance matrix
sigma <- diag(sigmas) %*% rho %*% diag(sigmas)

# how many cafes would you like?
n_cafes <- 20

set.seed(5) # used to replicate example

vary_effects <-
  MASS::mvrnorm(n_cafes, mu, sigma) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  set_names("a_cafe", "b_cafe")

n_visits <- 10
sigma <- 0.5 # std dev within cafes

set.seed(6) # used to replicate example

d <-
  vary_effects %>% 
  mutate(cafe = 1:n_cafes) %>% 
  expand_grid(visit = 1:n_visits) %>% 
  mutate(afternoon = rep(0:1, times = n() / 2)) %>% 
  mutate(mu = a_cafe + b_cafe * afternoon) %>% 
  mutate(wait = rnorm(n = n(), mean = mu, sd = sigma)) %>% 
  select(cafe, everything())
```


```{r}
# train model b (with rho = 0)
b14m1 <-
  brm(data = d,
      family = gaussian,
      wait ~ 1 + afternoon + (1 + afternoon | cafe),
      prior = c(prior(normal(5, 2), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(-1, 0.5), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sigma),
                prior(lkj(2), class = cor)),
      iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 4,
      seed = 867530,
      file = "fits/b14m1")
```
```{r}
b14m1 %>% 
  spread_draws(cor_cafe__Intercept__afternoon) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_cafe__Intercept__afternoon)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 14M2
```{r}
a <- 3.5 # average morning wait time
b <- -1 # average difference afternoon wait time
sigma_a <- 1 # std dev in intercepts
sigma_b <- 0.5 # std dev in slopes
rho <- -.7 # correlation between intercepts and slopes

# the next three lines of code simply combine the terms, above
mu <- c(a, b)

cov_ab <- sigma_a * sigma_b * rho
sigma <- matrix(c(sigma_a^2, cov_ab,
                  cov_ab, sigma_b^2), ncol = 2)

sigmas <- c(sigma_a, sigma_b) # standard deviation
rho <- matrix(c(1, rho,
                rho, 1), nrow = 2)

# now matrix multiply to get covariance matrix
sigma <- diag(sigmas) %*% rho %*% diag(sigmas)

# how many cafes would you like?
n_cafes <- 20

set.seed(5) # used to replicate example

vary_effects <-
  MASS::mvrnorm(n_cafes, mu, sigma) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  set_names("a_cafe", "b_cafe")

n_visits <- 10
sigma <- 0.5 # std dev within cafes

set.seed(22) # used to replicate example

d <-
  vary_effects %>% 
  mutate(cafe = 1:n_cafes) %>% 
  expand_grid(visit = 1:n_visits) %>% 
  mutate(afternoon = rep(0:1, times = n() / 2)) %>% 
  mutate(mu = a_cafe + b_cafe * afternoon) %>% 
  mutate(wait = rnorm(n = n(), mean = mu, sd = sigma)) %>% 
  select(cafe, everything())
```

```{r}
b14m2_no_corr <-
  brm(data = d,
      family = gaussian,
      wait ~ 1 + afternoon + (1 + afternoon || cafe),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 10), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 10), class = b),
                prior(cauchy(0, 1), class = sd),
                prior(cauchy(0, 1), class = sigma)),
      iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 8,
      seed = 867530,
      file = "fits/b14m2_no_corr")
```


```{r}
b14m2_corr <- 
  brm(data = d,
      family = gaussian,
      wait ~ 1 + afternoon + (1 + afternoon | cafe),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 10), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 10), class = b),
                prior(cauchy(0, 1), class = sd),
                prior(cauchy(0, 1), class = sigma),
                prior(lkj(2), class = cor)),
      iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, chains = 4, cores = 8,
      seed = 867530,
      file = "fits/b14m2_corr")
```

```{r}
b14m2_corr <- add_criterion(b14m2_corr, criterion = "waic")
b14m2_no_corr <- add_criterion(b14m2_no_corr, criterion = "waic")
```

```{r}
loo_compare(b14m2_corr, b14m2_no_corr, criterion = "waic")
```

### 14H1
```{r}
rm(list = ls())

data(bangladesh, package = "rethinking")
d <- bangladesh
rm(bangladesh)
```

```{r}
d$district_id <- as.integer(as.factor(d$district))
sort(unique(d$district_id))
```

```{r}
b14h1 <-
  brm(data = d,
      family = bernoulli,
      use.contraception ~ 1 + urban + (1 + urban | district_id),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(lkj(2), class = cor)),
      iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, chains = 4, cores = 8,
      seed = 14,
      file = "fits/b14h1")
```

```{r}
summary(b14h1)
```

```{r}
# Chat GPT

# Get posterior summaries of group-level effects
coef_df <- coef(b14h1)$district_id %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("district_id") %>%
  rename(
    intercept = Estimate.Intercept,
    slope_urban = Estimate.urban
  ) %>%
  select(district_id, intercept, slope_urban)

# Define inverse logit
inv_logit <- function(x) plogis(x)

# Add predicted probabilities
coef_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(
    prob_rural = inv_logit(intercept),
    prob_urban = inv_logit(intercept + slope_urban)
  )

ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = intercept, y = slope_urban)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "District-level correlation: Intercept vs Urban Slope",
    x = "Intercept (log-odds for rural)",
    y = "Slope (urban effect)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
fixef_df <- fixef(b14h1)  # This gives the fixed effects: beta_0, beta_1

draws_data <- 
  b14h1 %>% 
  tidy_draws() %>%
  select(.draw, b_Intercept, b_urban, contains("r_district_id[")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("r_district_id[")) %>%
  mutate(
    district_id = as.integer(str_extract(name, "\\d+")),
    type = if_else(str_detect(name, "Intercept"), "Intercept", "Slope"),
    fixed = if_else(type == "Intercept", b_Intercept, b_urban),
    value = value + fixed
  ) %>%
  select(.draw, district_id, type, value) 

draws_wide <-
  draws_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)
```

```{r}
draws_summary <- draws_wide %>%
  group_by(district_id) %>%
  summarise(
    intercept_mean = mean(Intercept),
    slope_mean = mean(Slope),
    intercept_lower = quantile(Intercept, 0.025),
    intercept_upper = quantile(Intercept, 0.975),
    slope_lower = quantile(Slope, 0.025),
    slope_upper = quantile(Slope, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(draws_summary, aes(x = intercept_mean, y = slope_mean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "District-level correlation: Intercept vs Urban Slope (with uncertainty)",
    x = "Intercept (log-odds for rural)",
    y = "Slope (urban effect)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
nd <- 
  tibble(
  district_id = 1:60) %>% 
  expand_grid(urban = 0:1)
```


```{r}
plot_df <-
  nd %>% 
  add_epred_draws(b14h1) %>%
  group_by(district_id, urban) %>% 
  mean_hdci(.epred) %>% 
  select(district_id:.upper) %>% 
  mutate(urban = if_else(urban == 1, "urban", "rural")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = urban, values_from = c(.epred, .lower, .upper)) %>% 
  mutate(
    .epred_diff = .epred_urban - .epred_rural,
    .lower_diff = .lower_urban - .lower_rural,
    .upper_diff = .upper_urban - .upper_rural
  )
  
p1 <- 
  plot_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = .epred_rural, y = .epred_urban)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 1, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- 
  plot_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = .epred_rural, y = .epred_diff)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 1, color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()

p1 + p2
```

### 14H3

```{r}
library(dagitty)

dag <- dagitty("
dag {
  age.centered -> living.children
  age.centered -> use.contraception
  living.children -> use.contraception
  urban -> use.contraception
  district -> use.contraception
}
")

plot(dag)
```
```{r}
b14h3_a <-
  brm(data = d,
      family = bernoulli,
      use.contraception ~ 1 + urban + age.centered + (1 + urban | district_id),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(lkj(2), class = cor)),
      iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, chains = 4, cores = 8,
      seed = 14,
      file = "fits/b14h3_a")
```

```{r}
b14h3_b <-
  brm(data = d,
      family = bernoulli,
      use.contraception ~ 1 + urban + age.centered + living.children + (1 + urban | district_id),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(lkj(2), class = cor)),
      iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, chains = 4, cores = 8,
      seed = 14,
      file = "fits/b14h3_b")
```

```{r}
summary(b14h3_a)
```

```{r}
summary(b14h3_b)
```
1. Posterior Prediction (with tidybayes)
```{r}
mean_age <- mean(d$age)  # for centering reference
newdata <- tibble(
  age.centered = 30 - mean_age,
  urban = 1,
  living.children = 2,
  district_id = NA  # exclude group-level effects
)
```


```{r}
b14h3_b %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .epred)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Posterior Prediction: Probability of Contraception Use",
       x = "Predicted Probability", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```

2. Mediation Plot via Posterior Simulation
```{r}
# Fit the mediator model
b_mediator <- brm(
  living.children ~ age.centered,
  data = d,
  family = poisson(),  # use negative binomial if overdispersed
  prior = prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, cores = 4
)
```

```{r}
# Predict number of children for different ages
age_seq <- tibble(age.centered = seq(-15, 15, length.out = 50))

pred_children <- b_mediator %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = age_seq, re_formula = NA) %>%
  group_by(age.centered) %>%
  summarise(.epred = mean(.epred))
```

```{r}
# Predict contraception use for each age via predicted children
# Join predicted children back with age
age_seq_with_kids <- pred_children %>%
  rename(living.children = .epred) %>%
  mutate(urban = 1, district_id = NA)

# Predict contraception
b14h3_b %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = age_seq_with_kids, re_formula = NA) %>%
  group_by(age.centered) %>%
  median_qi(.epred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age.centered, y = .epred)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Mediated Effect of Age via Children on Contraception Use",
       x = "Age (centered)", y = "Predicted Probability of Use") +
  theme_minimal()
```

3. Visualize Posterior Distribution
```{r}
b14h3_b %>%
  spread_draws(b_age.centered, b_living.children, b_urban) %>%
  select(-c(.chain, .iteration, .draw)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = name)) +
  stat_halfeye(fill = "skyblue", .width = 0.89) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Posterior Distributions of Coefficients (Model B)",
       x = "Effect Size (Log-Odds)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Compare the same parameter between models
bind_rows(
  tidy_draws(b14h3_a) %>% select(b_age.centered) %>% mutate(model = "Model A"),
  tidy_draws(b14h3_b) %>% select(b_age.centered) %>% mutate(model = "Model B")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("b_")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = model)) +
  stat_halfeye(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Effect of age.centered With and Without Mediator",
       x = "Effect on Contraception Use (Log-Odds)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
age_seq <- tibble(
  age.centered = seq(-15, 15, by = 1),
  urban = 1,
  living.children = 2,
  district_id = NA
)

b14h3_b %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = age_seq, re_formula = NA) %>%
  group_by(age.centered) %>%
  median_qi(.epred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age.centered, y = .epred)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper), alpha = 0.3, fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Predicted Probability of Contraception Use Across Age",
       x = "Age (centered)", y = "Predicted Probability") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 14H4 & 14H5
```{r}
rm(list = ls())

data(Oxboys, package = "rethinking")
d <- Oxboys
rm(Oxboys)
```

```{r}
standardize <- function(x){
  return (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}
```

```{r}
d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(height = standardize(height))
```

```{r}
b14h4 <-
  brm(data = d,
      family = gaussian,
      height ~ 1 + age + (1 + age | Subject),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sigma),
                prior(lkj(2), class = cor)),
      iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, chains = 4, cores = 8,
      seed = 14,
      file = "fits/b14h4")
```

```{r}
summary(b14h4)
```

```{r}
draws_data <-
  b14h4 %>% 
  tidy_draws() %>%
  select(.draw, b_Intercept, b_age, contains("r_Subject[")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("r_subject[")) %>% 
  mutate(
    Subject = as.integer(str_extract(name, "\\d+")),
    type = if_else(str_detect(name, "Intercept"), "Intercept", "Slope"),
    fixed = if_else(type == "Intercept", b_Intercept, b_age),
    value = value + fixed
  ) %>%
  select(.draw, Subject, type, value) 

draws_wide <-
  draws_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

draws_summary <- draws_wide %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(
    intercept_mean = mean(Intercept),
    slope_mean = mean(Slope),
    intercept_lower = quantile(Intercept, 0.025),
    intercept_upper = quantile(Intercept, 0.975),
    slope_lower = quantile(Slope, 0.025),
    slope_upper = quantile(Slope, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
draws_summary %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = intercept_mean, y = slope_mean)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 14H6
```{r}
draws_data <-
  b14h4 %>% 
  tidy_draws() %>% 
  select(b_Intercept, b_age, sd_Subject__Intercept, 
         sd_Subject__age, cor_Subject__Intercept__age, sigma) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  mean_hdci()
```

```{r}
S <- matrix(
  c(draws_data[[5, 2]]^2, 
    draws_data[[5, 2]] * draws_data[[4, 2]] * draws_data[[3, 2]],
    draws_data[[5, 2]] * draws_data[[4, 2]] * draws_data[[3, 2]],
    draws_data[[4, 2]]^2),
  nrow = 2)
```

```{r}
ve <- as_tibble(MASS::mvrnorm(10, c(0, 0), Sigma = S)) %>% 
  mutate(Subject = 1:10) %>% 
  select(Subject, everything()) %>% 
  rename(Intercept = V1,
         Slope = V2) %>% 
  mutate(
    int_fixed = draws_data[[2, 2]],
    slope_fixed = draws_data[[1, 2]]) %>% 
  expand_grid(age = c(-1,1)) %>% 
  mutate(height = int_fixed + Intercept + (slope_fixed + Slope) * age)
```

```{r}
ve %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = age, y = height, group = Subject)) +
  theme_minimal()
```
